title: T7 — sealed cavity driven by cell zones
request: A sealed rectangular cavity of air, 100 mm x 60 mm x 40 mm, for a natural convection solve. There is no inlet and no outlet — every boundary is an adiabatic wall. Inside it, mark two cell zones I can put a heat source and a heat sink on: a 20 mm cube near the floor at one end called `heater`, and a matching one near the ceiling at the other end called `cooler`.
properties: both cell zones present by name, with their cell counts and their centroids
zone size, 20 mm cube each, and their positions relative to floor and ceiling
the boundary is a single named patch covering the whole cavity

run.summary: Now 6 named wall patches (`westWall`, `eastWall`, `southWall`, `northWall`, `floor`, `ceiling`), each measured with correct area/centre/outward normal, all type `wall`, forming a full closed enclosure (mesh_look confirms `"enclosure"` lists all six as a closed set) — no inlet/outlet patches exist, consistent with the sealed adiabatic cavity requested. Same 100×60×40 mm domain, same `heater`/`cooler` 20 mm cellZones as before, checkMesh clean.

All 6 patches present, areas correct (endA/endB = 0.06×0.04=0.0024 m², sideA/sideB = 0.1×0.04=0.004 m², floor/ceiling = 0.1×0.06=0.006 m²), normals point outward correctly. checkMesh clean, mesh unchanged (1920 cells, 2 zones of 64 cells/8e-6 m³ each, correctly placed). Sum of patch areas = 2*(0.0024+0.004+0.006)=0.0248 m² matching total surface area of the box.
Built a sealed 100×60×40 mm rectangular cavity as an 18-block structured hex mesh (blockMesh), 1920 cells, with two 20 mm cube `cellZones` (`heater`, `cooler`) placed at opposite ends — heater on the floor at x=0..20mm, cooler at the ceiling at x=80..100mm, both centered in y — and 6 named adiabatic `wall` patches (`floor`, `ceiling`, `endA`, `endB`, `sideA`, `sideB`), no inlet/outlet as the cavity is sealed. checkMesh reports a clean orthogonal mesh (max skewness ~1.6e-14, non-orthogonality 0). Not checked: no BCs or fluid properties were set, per the task's scope — only patch names/types and cellZones were established for a later solver setup.
